entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your full name and the order number?
Sarah Jenkins. Order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 16th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I just don't like it. The interface is confusing. It's really hard to use.
I see. I'm sorry to hear you're not enjoying the VeloBand. Sometimes the advanced features can take a little getting used to. Did you happen to consult the quick start section in the user manual?
I glanced at it. Frankly, I expected more for what I paid. I'm not interested in a tutorial, I just want to send it back.
Understood, Sarah. No problem at all. Let me just pull up our return policy to confirm the eligibility for you.
Alright, I've checked the policy here in our system. It looks like you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Fine. So you'll take it back?
Yes, absolutely. I'm processing that for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account. You should receive it momentarily.
Whatever. About time something was simple.

I do apologize for any inconvenience. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Can I help with anything else?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
